summary: Frontend-only verification for LiveTaskPopup show-once fix + drag/resize/persisted-geometry feature (ORA CTO app). Ran the two new vitest suites plus the pre-existing p5 regression suite. All 13/13 tests pass. Also verified the ChatPanel source-level gating is in place at both call sites (history-hydration effect at line 1372-1379 and ora-task-handoff window listener at line 1455-1457), and confirmed LiveTaskPopup.jsx exposes the correct data-testids (live-task-popup, ltp-drag-handle, ltp-close-btn, ltp-resize-handle) with correct geometry math (min 300x160, persisted to localStorage 'ora_ltp_geometry', default fallback left:24/bottom:96).
critical_code_review_comments: LiveTaskPopup.jsx is ~624 lines — still under the 700-line threshold but getting close. Consider extracting the drag/resize hook (startDrag/onDragMove/onDragEnd/startResize/onResizeMove/onResizeEnd + _loadGeom/_saveGeom) into a small useDraggableResizable hook if this component grows again.

Drag/resize listeners are attached to window on mousedown but if the component unmounts mid-drag (e.g., taskId becomes null while user is dragging) the mousemove/mouseup listeners are not cleaned up in a useEffect return. Low-probability edge case since taskId rarely changes mid-drag, but worth a safety cleanup effect.

Geometry is stored under a single global localStorage key ('ora_ltp_geometry') — shared across all users on the same browser profile. Acceptable for a single-tenant preview but if multi-user on same machine matters later, key it by user id.

Minor: onDragMove uses cached d.width/d.height captured at mousedown — if the popup is resized while being dragged (not currently possible in the UI, but defensively), the clamp math would drift. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the reopen-on-refresh bug: the effect keyed on `latestAssistant?.shipped_task_id` fires whenever chat history rehydrates from the backend on mount, so ANY historical shipped assistant message would re-trigger setLivePopupTaskId on every login/refresh. Fix: gate both surfacing paths with a localStorage-persisted 'seen ids' set, marking seen the moment the popup is surfaced. Verified via source-level assertions in ChatPanel.ltp_show_once_2026_08_30.test.jsx (4 checks pass).
